system.description: You have rejected the role of the caste into which you were Embraced, choosing instead to define your own existence and follow the path of another caste. While many Assamites take this course with few repercussions, you have made enough waves to gain a certain notoriety — perhaps you publicly spurned your heritage, or asked a mentor of another caste to take you as his surrogate childe. Your sire refuses to acknowledge your existence, and other members of your birth caste treat you with scorn. You suffer a two-Trait penalty on all Social challenges dealing with members of your Embrace caste.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
